title: The Fast Way to Find 25%, 50%, or 75% of Anything
description: Percentages are just fractions in disguise — halves and quarters make finding common percentages almost instant.
narration_lines: Finding 50, 25, or 75 percent is just fractions in disguise.
75% is three quarters, so first find one quarter. 80 divided by 4 is 20.
Then multiply that by 3 for three quarters.

steps.label: 75% is 3 quarters — find one quarter first
